product_overview: Mosque Dashboard is a web portal for mosque visitors and administrators to access public information, manage donations and registrations, and run daily mosque operations. It combines a public-facing site with a protected admin dashboard for finances, programs, congregation data, inventory, ZISWAF, and settings.
core_goals: View mosque information, prayer times, news, and financial transparency on the public site
Submit online donations and congregation registration from the public landing page
Authenticate mosque administrators to access protected management tools
Manage work programs, congregation records, financial transactions, inventory, and ZISWAF collections
Review dashboards, reports, and settings to support mosque operations

features.name: Public Landing Page & Quick Donation
features.description: Visitors can browse mosque information, prayer times, agendas, and financial snapshots, then submit a public donation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse landing page sections -> Open the donation flow -> Fill donor name, donation type, amount, and notes -> Submit donation form -> View donation confirmation and payment details

features.name: Public Congregation Registration
features.description: Visitors can register themselves as mosque congregation members through a public form.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the registration section -> Enter full name, phone number, address, and RT/RW -> Select marital status, occupation, and family member count -> Submit registration form -> See a success message

features.name: Financial Transparency Portal
features.description: The public can inspect mosque financial summaries, transaction lists, and allocation charts.
user_flows: Navigate to /transparansi-keuangan -> View balance, income, and expenditure summaries -> Filter transactions by period and category -> Search donation and expense records -> Switch between cash flow and fund allocation charts

features.name: Public News & Activity Articles
features.description: Visitors can browse published mosque news, articles, announcements, and activity updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /berita-kegiatan -> Browse the list of published posts -> Filter content by category -> Search by keyword -> Open an article to view its details

features.name: DKM Administrator Login
features.description: Administrators can sign in to access the protected mosque management dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /portal-dkm -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Toggle password visibility if needed -> Submit login form -> See the dashboard after successful login
Navigate to /portal-dkm -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See an error alert

features.name: Dashboard Overview & KPI Metrics
features.description: Authenticated administrators can review operational summaries, financial KPIs, charts, upcoming programs, and recent activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View total balance, income, and expense summary cards -> Review cash flow and category distribution charts -> Inspect upcoming programs and recent transactions -> Follow a quick action to a management page

features.name: Work Program Management
features.description: Administrators can create, track, update, complete, and remove mosque work programs.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/program-kerja -> Filter programs by status -> Search programs by name or category -> Open the add-program flow -> Enter title, date, budget, PIC, and description -> Submit the new program -> See it appear in the program list
Navigate to /dashboard/program-kerja -> Open an existing program -> Update program details -> Save changes -> See the updated record in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/program-kerja -> Open an existing program -> Change its status -> See the new status reflected in the tracker
Navigate to /dashboard/program-kerja -> Open an existing program -> Enter realized budget, notes, and documentation -> Mark the program complete -> See the program move to completed status
Navigate to /dashboard/program-kerja -> Open an existing program -> Delete the program -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Congregation (Jemaah) Management
features.description: Administrators can search, add, edit, delete, and export congregation member records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/jemaah -> Search members by name, phone, or address -> Apply filters by category, gender, or RT/RW -> Review matching member records
Navigate to /dashboard/jemaah -> Open the add-member flow -> Enter personal details -> Submit the form -> See the new jemaah record in the database
Navigate to /dashboard/jemaah -> Open a member profile -> Review member details and history -> Edit member information -> Save changes -> See the updated profile
Navigate to /dashboard/jemaah -> Open a member record -> Delete the record -> See it removed from the database
Navigate to /dashboard/jemaah -> Export the member list -> Receive the data file

features.name: Financial Ledger & Transaction Management
features.description: Administrators can record income and expense transactions, organize them by category, and export financial records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/keuangan -> Filter transactions by type, category, or date range -> Search by description or donor name -> Review matching ledger entries
Navigate to /dashboard/keuangan -> Open the add-transaction flow -> Choose transaction type, category, amount, payment method, and description -> Submit the transaction -> See the ledger update
Navigate to /dashboard/keuangan -> Open an existing transaction -> Edit the transaction details -> Save changes -> See the updated entry
Navigate to /dashboard/keuangan -> Open an existing transaction -> Delete the transaction -> See it removed from the ledger
Navigate to /dashboard/keuangan -> Download a receipt or export the financial report -> Receive the exported file

features.name: Inventory & Asset Management
features.description: Administrators can maintain an asset registry with item condition, quantity, location, and acquisition details.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/inventaris -> Search assets by code or item name -> Filter by condition or location -> Review the matching inventory list
Navigate to /dashboard/inventaris -> Open the add-asset flow -> Enter name, quantity, condition, room location, and purchase date -> Submit the asset -> See it added to the inventory
Navigate to /dashboard/inventaris -> Open an existing asset -> Update its condition or quantity -> Save changes -> See the revised asset record
Navigate to /dashboard/inventaris -> Open an obsolete asset -> Delete the asset -> See it removed from inventory

features.name: ZISWAF Management
features.description: Administrators can calculate zakat, record ZISWAF donations, and track distribution to beneficiary categories.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/ziswaf -> Use the zakat calculator -> Review the calculated amount
Navigate to /dashboard/ziswaf -> Open the donation recording flow -> Enter muzakki details and zakat type -> Submit the record -> See the ZISWAF transaction added
Navigate to /dashboard/ziswaf -> Review distribution tracking by asnaf category -> Inspect the collection summary metrics

features.name: Mosque Settings & Profile
features.description: Administrators can update mosque identity, contact details, banking information, logo, and interface preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Update mosque profile details -> Save the changes -> See the updated organization information
Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Upload or change the mosque logo -> Save the changes -> See the new branding applied
Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Toggle system theme or preferences -> Save the settings -> See the interface update
